$comment: Limits = measured values + headroom: bytes +5 % (rounded up to 0.5 KB), element counts +3 %, request counts (modules, stylesheets) exact. Re-baseline on purpose with `npm run test:budget -- --update` and review the diff.
notes: 2026-10-07 (round-1 integration, PK7). Fixed before re-baselining: card images capped at 800w (2x; phones no longer take 1200w: /ar/projects/ on a Pixel 7 772 -> 509 KB, about the pre-round 514 KB); hero photo panel `sizes` from the image's aspect ratio and the hero height instead of a flat 80vw (/ar/technologies/ desktop back to the pre-round 54 KB at 1x / 124 KB at 2x); gallery widths gained a 960 step; print CSS moved to its own media=print sheet; dev-only pages no longer feed the production CSS. The measuring script now counts a <picture> split by `media` (desktop panel vs phone band) once instead of twice and follows JS static imports.

Intended growth accepted: HTML +3-9 KB gzip per page (header dropdowns + drawer accordions with icons, full footer lists, back-to-top, motion toggle, 'On this page' bars, CSP <meta> with per-page script hashes ~0.4 KB); external JS on every page 3-9 KB gzip (motion preference + toggle, FAB/back-to-top, hero video pause; previously 0 because the old scripts were inlined); global CSS 22.3 -> 26.2 KB gzip (nav, grids, FAB, view transitions, motion system, lang links, copy button, TOC chips); ControlLoop/HMI CSS + hmi-demo.js (lazy) from the compositor-only animation rewrite; images: new 'Panels we have built' grid on /services/control-panels/, panel-photo covers on case-study cards, the 820px lead photo in 3-photo galleries.

2026-10-07 (round-2 perf, Q1). One site module per page (src/scripts/site.ts + integrations/site-scripts.mjs): every page now has exactly 1 external module script (was 4-9) and none with a chained static import, so `js` is the same ~8.5 KB gzip site module everywhere (more on text pages that had ~4 KB, less on the home that had ~11 KB); page features load on demand (not counted). Hero photos preloaded from <head> (integrations/hero-preload.mjs) and phones at >=2.5x capped at ~2x (HeroBand/card `sizes`). The phone drawer now renders after the footer (beforeMain ~15 -> ~12 KB gzip). New keys: beforeMain (gzip HTML before <main>), elements, stylesheets (render-blocking <link>s, head + body), modules. `images` now picks srcset candidates like a browser (sizes x DPR for a 412px@2.625 phone and a 1440px@1x desktop) instead of the largest candidate, so its values dropped without any image getting smaller. Headroom tightened: bytes +5 %, elements +3 %, request counts exact. Re-run --update once the other round-2 fixes land; the hard checks (hero preloads, chained modules, speculation rules, versioned /media files) are not budgets and must stay green.

2026-10-07 (round-2 integration, Q7). Re-baselined after all round-2 fixes landed. Intended growth: 404 HTML 8.4 -> 10.7 KB gzip (UX2-26 'Did you mean': the real section / service / industry / case-study paths and their localized names embedded for the inline suggestion script, ~2.8 KB raw); the largest CSS file +~0.5 KB gzip (compact /projects/ filter bar, ViewAll pill, coarse-pointer targets, hover gating). Locked-in savings: card photos cropped to the card's box at build time (PERF2-10): images on /projects/ 391 -> 304 KB and industry pages 194 -> 142 KB per worst page; the Arabic pages no longer download Montserrat (37 KB font, PERF2-12: Latin islands in Alexandria's Latin, WECON wordmark outlined) — fonts are not a per-page budget, checked by hand: /ar/, /ar/services/, /ar/technologies/, /ar/foreign-manufacturers/ fetch only the two Alexandria files.
